description.zh:
返回信息的语言类型：

- zh：中文
- en：英文
description.en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh: Chinese

- en: English

description.zh: 是否下单之后自动支付，如果此值为false，此接口将会返回订单支付url，可手动确认支付
description.en: Specifies whether to automatically pay after placing an order. If this value is false, this interface will return a payment URL for the order, which you can manually confirm to pay

descriptions.zh: 更新注册配置中心集群节点数或规格（支持按量付费和包年包月，增加节点或升级规格会产生相应资费，具体详情，请参见[价格说明]（[`~~1806469~~`]））。
descriptions.en: Updates the number of nodes or specifications of a registry and configuration center cluster (supports both pay-as-you-go and subscription). Adding nodes or upgrading specifications will incur corresponding fees. For more information, see \[Pricing]\(`~~1806469~~`).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse update-cluster-spec --cluster-id mse-09k1q110000 --instance-id mse-cn-st21ri20000 --instance-count 3 --cluster-specification MSE_SC_2_4_200_c --mse-version mse_pro --pub-network-flow 1 --auto-pay true --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
